note: Third screening on medium land maps, played to the end (day limit 300): eight switches or groups of switches on the base {"magicWorth": 1} (to be replaced by what the screening d9283 confirms before this job starts), 2^(8-4) resolution IV, 24 games per configuration, shared pool. W = fightForecast 1: every fight against map guards is judged by simulated battle instead of the square law (7,555 logged guard fights: the simulator forecasts 4.1 % loss where 3.0 % was lost, and the real loss was more than five points above its forecast in one fight of twenty; the square law is right on average and wrong by a factor of three in 6 % of the fights). Z = seekTowns 1: a town we know of but have no way to draws the main hero and scouts through the fog (a logged game was lost 1:6 with the one known enemy town never approached). T = townAmbush 1 alone: near an enemy town the strongest enemy hero seen lately counts as present (on an islands map the main hero sailed to the enemy's capital with 4,000 on day 6 and was dead on day 11). S = scouts 2; U = surrender 2; I = idleBuild 1 + spareStock 1 + magicFocus 2; H = noChase 0 (chasing also on campaign); F = standFast 1 (behind our walls when nothing is safe). Evaluate with arena/effects.py and arena/metrics.py: --factors '{"W": {"fightForecast": 1}, "Z": {"seekTowns": 1}, "T": {"townAmbush": 1}, "S": {"scouts": 2}, "U": {"surrender": 2}, "I": {"idleBuild": 1, "spareStock": 1, "magicFocus": 2}, "H": {"noChase": 0}, "F": {"standFast": 1}}' (configurations named by the letters that are on; 'base' = the base alone).
